# Provenance

A v0.2 bundle that adopts §5 — and one concept that adopts none of it, so the
suppression rule is visible inside a single bundle rather than only between two.

* [Ledger](ledger.md) - human-reviewed, and deprecated
* [Sweep](sweep.md) - machine-confirmed, and expiring
* [Draft Note](draft-note.md) - declared `generated`, verified by nobody
* [Untouched](untouched.md) - declares no §5 family at all

## Records
* [Records](records/) - what the ledger is built from
